description: Pass 1 grounded entity research bundle. Designed to preserve provenance, ambiguity, and evidence for structured normalization in Pass 2.

entities.description: Entity candidates extracted across transcription variants. May include unresolved or ambiguous items.

items.description: A single entity record derived from grounded research in Pass 1.

canonical.description: Best-supported standardized name. If unresolved, use the format 'Unresolved: <best guess>'.

observed_variants.description: All observed spellings, abbreviations, or partial forms of the entity across transcription variants.

items.description: A single observed textual variant with verbatim spelling preserved.

about.description: Brief background information explaining who or what the entity is and how it relates to the document.

role_in_document.description: The functional role this entity plays in the document (e.g., author, recipient, referenced commander, location of action).

disambiguation.description: Information distinguishing this entity from similarly named entities or alternative historical candidates.

resolution_notes.description: Explanation of how the canonical form was chosen from observed variants and sources, including any uncertainty.

confidence.description: Categorical confidence level in the correctness of the canonical identification.
